brief.rules:
FANTASY: I am the pier's meanest bumper driver, spinning rivals and hammering the huge ball home. Sensation and challenge.
WORLD: Kart 2 m long, 1.7 tall. Deck 36 by 22 body lengths; ball 1.2 body lengths. Cruise 6 body lengths a second, boost 9. Camera 4.7 body heights back, 4.1 up.
TEARDOWN: Rocket League kickoff: 3-second countdown, hold boost into the centre ball; tank 100, burns 33 a second, pads give 12 or 100. Copied; the conceding side starts fuller.
TEARDOWN: NHL '94 body check: drive into the carrier, they go down, puck runs loose. Changed: the victim spins up to 1.5 seconds, a live bat firing the ball along your hit.
TEARDOWN: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe battle spin-out: struck kart whirls, loses speed and a balloon, drives again within seconds. Spin and recovery copied; balloons dropped; spin immunity added.
30 SECONDS: 0-5 s countdown, my ringed kart, glowing ball; Shift, flames answer: 'that's me'. 5-15 s Bertha crosses side-on beside the ball; Space spins her, her flag streams goalward: 'got you'. 15-30 s I shove the ball into her spinning tub; it rockets along my hit line: 'I made that!'
KILL IF: after three goals a newcomer cannot say why they lost the ball.
KILL IF: a bump reads as two karts sliding apart, with no spin, jolt or clang.
KILL IF: after two minutes the player only boosts at the ball, never feeding it into a spun rival or guessing where it will fly.
KILL IF: the ball hides a rival's wind-up and the player says the hit came from nowhere.

MATCH. Three against three, no goalies. One match to 3 goals. At 180 s the leader wins; level means golden goal. Kickoff: 180-frame countdown, mirrored spots, centred ball, reset after every goal; goal hold 90 frames, skippable with Space. Everyone starts with 33 boost; the side that conceded starts with 66 (tail lamps glow).

SPEEDS (all in data/tuning.json). Cruise 12 m/s, boost 18; acceleration 14 m/s2, boosting 22; brake 24; reverse 6. Turn 3.2 rad/s cruising, 2.4 boosting. Carrier speed times 0.88, turn times 0.85. Kart tub 1.5 m wide. Ball radius 1.2 m, mass 0.25 of a kart, restitution 0.7, rolling drag 0.3 per second, cap 30 m/s. Boost tank 100, 33 a second; 10 small pads give 12 (return 4 s), 4 corner pads give 100 (return 10 s).

BALL STATE: loose, carried(owner), struck. Take: front cone 50 degrees, within 0.5 m of the nose, relative speed under 6 m/s; spring k 200 to a nose anchor. Faster touches deflect it along the line from kart centre to ball centre. Loss causes, shown by sound and the victim's motion: bumped off, spun out, whirled off, own boost turn (swing over 0.8 m for 6 frames). No retake for 30 frames by the old owner or rivals within 4 m; a new owner cannot be bumped loose for 12 frames.

VERBS. BUMP 5/7/12 (template poke): spring nose lunge, +4 m/s, contact cone 35 degrees, no auto-aim. On the ball it adds 14 m/s along the contact line; contact in the first three active frames (the sweet spot) adds 20. RAM: hold Shift, 6 frame wind-up, contact at closing speed 14 m/s or more is a ram, 12 frame recovery after release. WHIRL 4/18/24: guard pirouette on the spot, turns away bumps and rams, swats the ball at 14 m/s tangentially. Whirl is the guard; spin-out is what a struck kart suffers.

CONTACT TABLE (both karts, always). Touch under 6 m/s: both rebound, restitution 0.6, soft thud, no hit-stop. Bump on flank: victim spins out 75 frames, speed halved, ball freed; attacker recoils 3 m/s; 4 frames hit-stop both. Bump on rear: victim shoved 7 m/s forward, 24 frame wobble; attacker drops to half speed; 3 frames. Bump on nose: both rebound 5 m/s, drivers snap forward; 3 frames. Bump against bump: clash, both rebound 8 m/s, 5 frames. Ram on flank or rear: victim spins out 90 frames, thrown 6 m/s; attacker keeps 40% speed and jolts; 8 frames, shake. Ram head-on: both rebound 9 m/s, the slower spins out 75 frames; 6 frames. Bump or ram into a whirl: attacker spins out 75 frames, whirler holds ground and gains 10 boost; 6 frames. Whiffed bump: full 12 frame recovery, spring twang. Whiffed whirl: 24 frames no steering, speed times 0.6. Teammates only rebound. During a spin-out and 90 frames after, further hits only jolt both karts.

SPIN BAT (the twist). A spun-out kart brakes at 10 m/s2, so it stays near. The first ball touch on it, at any ball speed, sends the ball at a fixed 20 m/s along the hit direction: the attacker's travel line at contact (against a whirl, from the whirler through the attacker; head-on, the faster kart's line). The victim's flagpole pennant streams that way for the whole spin-out. One bat per spin-out. A 75 frame spin less your 12 frame recovery leaves about 1 s to feed it. Own goals count. Your kart can be used the same way. Rivals answer by blocking the feed line or bumping the feeder.

ANIMATION (pack script on visual parts, no biped clips). Bump: driver leans back, spring compresses, both lunge, wobble back. Ram: tub squats, nose lifts, driver hunches over the wheel; tub squashes on contact. Whirl: tub tilts and pirouettes, driver throws arms high. Spin-out: tub rocks, driver's head lolls, hands off the wheel. Rear and nose hits: driver jerks away from the blow. Goal: driver stands in the seat and waves.

READABILITY. The ball is 2.4 m across, taller than a kart, with a hot-coloured stitched seam rim and ground shadow. Every kart carries a 3 m flagpole, and every rival tell plays on it and the driver, above the ball. A pine-light ring sits under your kart; a wider team-colour ring marks the carrier. An edge arrow shows the ball when off screen.

FEEL. Input answered within 3 frames (driver pose, spring compresses). Hit-stop holds only the two karts, presentation only; every spin-out gets it, beyond the bar's knockdown-only rule, for the owner to judge. No technical markers at impacts. Camera never rotates with your own spin; it sits higher than the bar's 6 m by 3.5 m because the ball is taller than a kart.

FIRST MINUTE. Opens on the countdown. In match one Bertha then crosses side-on 3 m beside the centred ball, across your goalward lane, repeating every 6 s until spun once. For those first 15 s the other four bots loop the far half, driving (a teaching rule, for the owner to judge). Hint line: 'SHIFT boost, SPACE bump her side', then 'now feed her the ball', then 'E whirl' at the first charge bell.

INTENSITY. Calm countdown, kickoff peak, loose-ball scramble, pad-refill lull; after each goal a breath; match point quickens music and big pads return in 7 s; sunset golden goal climaxes.

END. Card names winner, goals, your spin-outs, spin-bat goals, biggest loss cause with its answer ('Nell whirled you 5 times: wait out the parasol'). R restarts within 2 s. A win unlocks the next night (Rookie, Pro, All-star pennants) and records fastest win.
brief.arena: A wooden seaside pier pavilion: oval-cornered deck 72 by 44 m, boards 1 m high with restitution 0.7, rounded 6 m corners so the ball never sticks. Goals at both ends 14 m wide, 4 m tall (kit goal scaled), team bunting. 10 small boost pads in two lanes, 4 big brass lamps in corners (TLTrigger). Roof arch ribs, light masts and flags stand at least 10 m beyond the boards, so the camera never meets them; no pillar on the play surface; sea all round. Camera: chase bound to your kart, 8 m back, 7 m up, look height 1, fov 46 (kart about 0.2 of frame height), about 4-frame lag, avoid_space on, occluder fade for any rib; heading frozen while you spin out. From this height the 1 m boards never hide play and rival flagpoles and drivers show over the 2.4 m ball. Ball has a hot seam rim; pine-light ring under your kart. During play the sky steps from gold to rose, lamps light at 90 s, golden goal turns the deck lanterns on.
brief.ai: All bots follow HOCKEY-ARCADE utility: SHOOT = 1.6 shot chance minus 0.3 pressure (veto under 0.08); KNOCK to mate = 1.2 lane safety x openness x (0.5 + gain), veto lane under 0.35; CARRY = 0.9 space x (1 - pressure) + 0.15; FEED = 1.4 x goal chance along a spun kart's flag line, vetoed if the ball cannot arrive before the spin ends or the line threatens own goal; defence PRESSURE, BLOCK lane, GUARD goal. Roles attacker, support, last defender re-sorted by time to ball with 0.3 s hysteresis; 0.15 commitment bonus. Following the owner's bar they decide every frame; tiers are clumsiness. TLSteer pursue, arrive, separate (6 m unless contesting). Every bot bump has a 24-frame tell: driver rears up and the flagpole whips back above the ball. RIVALS, Ghost Train Crew. BERTHA, the Wall: wide iron-green tub with tyre-stack bumper, bowler-hatted driver, brass bell atop the pole, heavier. Parks goal-side nose-on; head-on bumps rebound off her. Habit: bell swings and rings 30 frames, then she charges straight and cannot turn; sidestep and hit the flank; recovery 36 frames. Rings twice on scoring; driver slumps when spun. NELL, the Spinner: small striped teacup tub. Whirls when an attacker closes within 4 m in front; the parasol on her pole snaps open 24 frames before. Feint, then bump during her 24-frame recovery. Twirls parasol on scoring; it droops when beaten. VIC, the Dancer: long narrow coffin-nosed tub, tall black pennant. Swerves off your line and steals from the flank; two toots and the pennant flicks to the swerve side 24 frames before; ram where it points, or whirl. Driver bows on goals; shakes a fist when spun. TEAMMATES Polly (attacks, drives the goal, feeds spins) and Gus (covers): shoot freely, never take the ball off your nose, flash their lamp when open. TIERS Rookie / Pro / All-star: aim error 6 / 3.5 / 1.5 degrees, sweet-spot timing 20 / 50 / 75 percent, whirl read chance 25 / 50 / 70 percent, feed attempts 30 / 60 / 85 percent of openings; All-star feints, passes and blocks feed lines more. Equal speeds and boost. No bot stands still over 1 s.
brief.controls: drive: W throttle, S brake and reverse, A and D steer. boost: hold Shift to burn the tank and ram. bump: Space, spring nose lunge along your facing. whirl: E or right mouse, spinning guard that also swats the ball. restart: R after the end card. Your kart wears a pine-light ring; the huge ball has a hot seam rim and an edge arrow when off screen.
brief.mood: Golden-to-rose sunset over the sea, painted fairground tubs, brass lamps, flagpoles and bunting in the global inked toon style. Spring twangs, rubber thuds, brass bells, gull cries, crowd cheers (TLAudio), sparks only on rams, confetti on goals.

packages.contract:
Turns the core into 3 v 3 with no goalies. Player decisions: ball is NEVER held, no spin bat or FEED option, rivals are one mint team in identical karts with no names or special habits. Do not edit core files.
HOOK: gen/mod_teams.gd static generate(ctx) does ctx.root.set_meta("kk_mod_teams","scripts/teams/teams.gd"); also static build_pad(big: bool)->Node3D (flat disc / brass lamp post under 1 m, TLStyle.flat_material). teams.gd: mod_setup(ctx, game), mod_tick(frame), mod_state().
SETUP: game.add_kart("red_2","red",1), ("red_3","red",2), ("mint_2","mint",1), ("mint_3","mint",2); set kart.brain on all five bots (replaces mint_1's brain_core; the core still drives mint_1 during game.lesson_active()). brain.think(kart, game) -> {throttle: -1..1, steer: -1..1, boost, bump, whirl}; bump/whirl true on the press frame; the core adds the 24 f tell to every bot bump, ram and whirl. While game.far_loop_active() the four other bots drive loops in the far half (z<-12) and never approach the ball.
AI (copy the structure of engine/packs/hockey/scripts/ai/carrier.gd and roles.gd; weights in data/ai.json): decide every frame, no reaction delay. Roles &"attacker",&"support",&"last" re-sorted by time to ball, 0.3 s hysteresis; commitment bonus 0.15. Options &"shoot" = 1.6*shot_chance - 0.3*pressure (veto under 0.08); &"knock" (to a mate) = 1.2*lane_safety*openness*(0.5+gain) (veto lane under 0.35); &"push" = 0.9*space*(1-pressure) + 0.15; defence &"pressure",&"block",&"guard". Never aim at the own goal. TLSteer.pursue, arrive, separate 6 m unless contesting (keeps scrum_share <= 0.3). Bump the ball to shoot or knock; bump or ram opponents on flank or rear; read a closing attacker and whirl when it is within 9 m (the 24 f tell plus 4 f wind-up must finish before contact). No bot stands still over 60 f.
MATES: red_2 attacks and drives the goal, red_3 covers; both shoot freely, give way when p1 is about to touch the ball (stay 4 m off p1's nose), and flash TailLamps when open (lane safety*openness over 0.6).
TIERS read game.tier 0 rookie,1 pro,2 allstar: aim_error_deg 6/3.5/1.5; sweet_chance 0.20/0.50/0.75; whirl_read 0.25/0.50/0.70; allstar also feints (starts a tell, drives off), knocks and blocks lanes more. Mates use pro. Equal speeds, accel and boost on every tier. All randomness ctx.rng.

Pickup by distance 1.5 m in the plane, game.add_boost(kart, v), capped 100; an empty pad visibly sinks or dims; all return on countdown_start. Sound on pickup. Low bots detour to pads when it costs under 1 s. Append event {type:"pad", kart, amount, big} to game.events.
